question: Will Bitcoin (BTC) trade at or above $80,000 at any time before 25 December 2026 00:00 UTC?
description: BTC fell from about $74,000 on 12 November to about $61,000 on 23 November 2026.
resolutionSource: CoinGecko daily USD price page for the asset (coingecko.com), cross-checked with Coinbase and Kraken spot prices.

resolutionRules.yesCriteria: Resolve YES if any 1-minute BTC/USD trade on Coinbase or Kraken prints at or above $80,000.00 between market creation and 24 December 2026 23:59:59 UTC.
resolutionRules.noCriteria: Resolve NO if no qualifying trade prints at or above $80,000.00 before 25 December 2026 00:00 UTC.
resolutionRules.invalidCriteria: Resolve Invalid if the event is cancelled or the outcome cannot be established using these rules.
resolutionRules.evidenceRequirements: Provide the source URL, observation time in UTC, and a copy or reference to the published result.
resolutionRules.conflictingEvidencePolicy: Use the named source as authoritative. Document any revisions and apply the same cutoff to both outcomes.
